recommendation: Keep the combined-branch commit as the core reconciliation for FHIR-22128. If identical explicit SHALL wording is desired for the minLength extension, make that follow-up in the FHIR Extension Pack repository rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-22128 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked for ElementDefinition.maxLength plus the minLength extension to be constrained to simple data types such as string/date, not complex types such as Coding, with validation tooling enforcing the limitation.
initial_application: The source had been partially updated by FHIR-20925 commit fce5daa6e5be65acdae0d73ed5aa36503e75b532, which changed ElementDefinition.maxLength to a string-oriented short description and a SHOULD-level primitive-type note. No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-22128 was found. The minLength extension was removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 and is now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-08-22 confirm the FHIR-22128 reopen and Persuasive with Modification vote. A Zulip thread records discussion that the primitive-type rule was hard to express as FHIRPath and should be enforced in validator logic. Later FHIR-49226 broadened maxLength support to date/dateTime/time and changed the same sentence, but left string-specific/weak wording and introduced typos. source/fhir.ini shows ElementDefinition is active normative core build source.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml to change the maxLength short description to primitive type data and the long definition to say maxLength SHALL only be used on primitive data types where character length has meaning, not complex types such as Coding. The edit also fixes the Type Characteristics typo/link text. No core minLength source was edited because it now belongs to the Extension Pack.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: revised ElementDefinition.maxLength short and definition text to match the primitive/simple-type restriction and fix the Type Characteristics typo.
